subject: Insurance
title: Training Data and Hidden Bias
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Training Data and Hidden Bias.

hook.text: An AI trained on historical data learned to charge higher premiums to minority neighborhoods.

buildup.text: Insurance datasets span decades. They contain pricing decisions made when racial discrimination was legal and common.

twist.text: Removing race from the model doesn't fix the bias.

climax.text: Fair AI insurance requires auditing for proxy discrimination.

punchline.text: Remove race, bias remains. Proxy variables keep old discrimination alive.

quiz.question: How can AI perpetuate discrimination even when race is removed from the model?
options: Proxy variables like ZIP code correlate with race indirectly
